payload.title: RAG corpus at 116 rows post-recovery (expected-ephemeral) — confirm re-populating, then re-run RAG-FTS AC#1 at scale
payload.context: qa RAG-FTS-BUILD-MEMORY-BOUND live-verify found rag_entries LanceDB table = 116 rows (rag_service.db absent). Documented pre-crash corpus ~56k rows. Per VM-crash recovery memory, RAG LanceDB embeddings are ephemeral-by-design and rebuild via ongoing ragIndex() writes (NOT a market.db-class loss). RAG-FTS memory-bound fix (619eea227) is deployed + plumbing/no-regression verified, but AC#1 (no-OOM at ~56k rows) is UN-testable at 116 rows -> RAG-FTS parked in review, done_verified withheld.
actions: 1. Confirm rag_entries row-count is CLIMBING (re-embed pipeline alive), not stuck at 116. If stuck -> re-embed pipeline is broken = new bug for dev-rag-service.

2. Once corpus is representative (>= a scale that exercises FTS build memory), re-run RAG-FTS AC#1 (POST /admin/rebuild-fts under 768m cgroup, docker-stats peak-mem, 2x) to finally close RAG-FTS-BUILD-MEMORY-BOUND + unblock ALPHA-S2-RAG-FTS-REBUILD-CRON with a real peak-mem number.
3. Heads-up: rag-service idle mem is already ~92% of the 768m bound with zero FTS activity — factor into any ops mem-limit decision.
